products.title: 14K Gold North Star Stud Earrings, Lab Grown White Sapphire, Eight-Point Starburst
products.description:
An eight-pointed star in 14k gold, with a flush-set lab-grown white sapphire at the center of each stud. Bright faceted ridges run along every point, so the pair catches light at a small size, an easy Christmas gift that is worn all year.

THE PIECE
Each stud is an eight-pointed star: four long points 11.4 mm tip to tip and four short points 7.6 mm tip to tip. The center boss is 3.4 mm across and 1.8 mm thick. Every point has straight side walls 0.6 mm high and a low two-facet ridge, and ends in a rounded tip 0.8 mm wide. The back is flat polished gold.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.55 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.56 g in total with the stones. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

STONES
Two 2.0 mm round lab-grown white sapphires, one per stud, 0.068 ct in total. Each is flush set, table level with the gold, over a small hole that lets light and cleaning water through. The stones are set last, after all polishing.

LENGTH AND FIT
Each star measures 11.4 mm across the long points. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back. The post sits just above the center, so the star stays upright on the lobe.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Each star is cast in 14k gold in one piece, then the ridges are cut bright and polished. There is no solder: the post is laser welded into a small socket, so it keeps its hardness. The sapphire is set cold, after the last polish.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap and a soft brush. Keep lotion out of the small hole behind the stone. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

A six-sided icicle in solid 14k gold, hanging from a small hexagonal post top, with six long polished facets that flash as it moves. It is a clean geometric drop for winter, a natural Christmas gift that keeps working in every season.

THE PIECE
A flat hexagonal top, 3.4 mm across flats and 0.9 mm thick, sits on the lobe. From its lower edge a 1.0 mm gold ring holds the icicle by a small closed loop. The icicle is solid, 10.5 mm long, 2.2 mm across flats at the top and 0.8 mm at the rounded tip. Overall length about 17 mm.

Made to order. The hexagon and the icicle are cast in 14k gold, the six facets are flattened and polished by hand, and the ring is closed with a 1.0 mm gold insert laser welded at both ends. There is no solder, and the post is laser welded, so it stays hard.

products.description:
A small gold crescent with a traditional evil eye hanging below it, enamelled in navy-blue, white and ice-blue glass. It is a protection charm in 14k gold, given as a Christmas gift and worn all year.

THE PIECE
A polished crescent, 4.8 mm wide and 3.2 mm tall with its points up, sits on the lobe. Below it a 1.0 mm gold ring holds a flat disc 5.4 mm across and 1.4 mm thick. The eye on the disc is 4.0 mm across, inside a 0.7 mm polished gold rim. Overall length about 12 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.69 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.73 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque, in the traditional nazar order from the outside inward: a navy-blue ring, a white ring and an ice-blue ring, each 0.5 mm wide, and a navy-blue center dot 1.0 mm across. The colours are laid side by side in one cell and fired together, so each colour edge is soft by a fraction of a millimetre. The enamel sits level with the gold rim or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
About 12 mm long, sitting just below the lobe; the disc moves freely on its ring. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The crescent and the disc are cast separately in zinc-free 14k gold, and the enamel cell is formed in the casting itself. The enamel is fired four times at no more than 780 C. There is no solder: the post is laser welded to the crescent, which never goes into the kiln, and the ring is closed with a laser weld well away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.

Resin is softer than glass and can scratch with wear. Avoid ultrasonic and steam cleaning and solvents, keep it away from chlorine, and clean it with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

products.description:
A small teardrop of ice-blue glass enamel in a polished 14k gold border, hanging point up from a domed gold disc. Clear winter blue for a Christmas gift, and a simple drop that is worn the whole year.

THE PIECE
A domed gold disc 3.4 mm across sits on the lobe. A 1.0 mm gold ring joins it to the teardrop, which is 7.2 mm long, 4.6 mm wide and 1.4 mm thick, with a 0.7 mm polished gold border. Overall length about 12.5 mm.

GOLD WEIGHT
1.69 g of 14k gold for the pair, counting both posts and friction backs. On the scale the finished pair weighs 1.72 g in total with the enamel. Each pair is weighed after finishing and checked against this design weight.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice-blue. The enamel fills the teardrop flat and level with the gold border or just below it. Glass does not fade, but a hard knock can chip it: keep the earrings away from chlorine and harsh chemicals, and clean the enamel with warm soapy water and a soft brush.

LENGTH AND FIT
About 12.5 mm long, sitting just below the lobe; the teardrop moves freely on its ring. A straight 14k gold post, 0.76 mm thick and 11.1 mm long, with a 14k gold friction back.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. The disc and the teardrop are cast separately in zinc-free 14k gold, and the enamel cell is formed in the casting itself. The enamel is fired four times at no more than 780 C. There is no solder: the post is laser welded to the disc, which never goes into the kiln, and the ring is closed with a laser weld well away from the enamel.

CARE
Store the pair on its own so harder pieces do not knock the enamel. Wipe the gold with a soft cloth. No ultrasonic or steam cleaning.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

Made to order. The processing time is shown at checkout.
